pr_title: fix: `list.get` does not work on list of decimals

issue_context.title: "list.get" operation does not work on list of decimals
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

pl.Config().activate_decimals()
df = pl.scan_parquet('path.parquet').collect()
df.select(pl.col('col').list.get(0))
```


### Log output

```shell
PanicException                            Traceback (most recent call last)
Cell In[17], line 1
----> 1 df.select(pl.col('col').list.get(0))

File /usr/twix/python3.11/lib/python3.11/site-packages/polars/dataframe/frame.py:8060, in DataFrame.select(self, *exprs, **named_exprs)
   7959 def select(
   7960     self, *exprs: IntoExpr | Iterable[IntoExpr], **named_exprs: IntoExpr
   7961 ) -> DataFrame:
   7962     """
   7963     Select columns from this DataFrame.
   7964 
   (...)
   8058 
   8059     """
-> 8060     return self.lazy().select(*exprs, **named_exprs).collect(_eager=True)

File /usr/twix/python3.11/lib/python3.11/site-packages/polars/lazyframe/frame.py:1749, in LazyFrame.collect(self, type_coercion, predicate_pushdown, projection_pushdown, simplify_expression, slice_pushdown, comm_subplan_elim, comm_subexpr_elim, no_optimization, streaming, background, _eager)
   1746 if background:
   1747     return InProcessQuery(ldf.collect_concurrently())
-> 1749 return wrap_df(ldf.collect())

PanicException: operator does not support primitive `Int128`
```


### Issue description

dataframe has schema of 
OrderedDict([('col', List(Decimal(precision=36, scale=18)))])

On the same array but of ints instead of decimals everything works fine

### Expected behavior

Similar behaviour to non-decimal types

comments:
Without needing a parquet I get the same

```
from decimal import Decimal
import polars as pl
pl.Config().activate_decimals()
df=pl.DataFrame({'a':[Decimal(f"1.{x}") for x in range(10)]}).select(pl.col('a').implode())
df.select(pl.col('a').list.get(0))
### results in
thread '<unnamed>' panicked at crates/polars-arrow/src/legacy/compute/take/mod.rs:26:33:
operator does not support primitive `Int128`

PanicException: operator does not support primitive `Int128`
```

Incidentally, it appears we can't construct like this either.
```
df=pl.DataFrame({'a':[[Decimal(f"1.{x}") for x in range(10)]]}, schema={'a':pl.List(pl.Decimal(None,2))})

thread '<unnamed>' panicked at crates/polars-core/src/chunked_array/builder/list/mod.rs:167:16:
not implemented for dtype Decimal(None, Some(1))

PanicException: not implemented for dtype Decimal(None, Some(1))
```
My "incidentally" is [covered here](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/13845)

The decimal dtype is not yet stable, there is still quite a long way to go...
